name: The Eye Of Vecna - A Byler Visual Novel
source:
Will is slowly losing himself as Vecna continues using him as a power source. What is going to happen when he decides to make a great sacrifice to save those he loves?

[From https://elmaxenjoyer.itch.io/the-eye-of-vecna]
translation:
当维克纳继续使用他作为力量源泉时，威尔正在慢慢失去自我。当他决定做出巨大牺牲来拯救他所爱的人时，会发生什么？

[来自https://elmaxenjoyer.itch.io/the-eye-of-vecna]
